verses.gurmukhi: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਹੁ ਬਾਹਰੇ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਜਗ ਵਿਚਿ ਆਏ।
verses.translit_en: ja(n)man maranahu baahare paraupakaaree jag vich aae|

en.bdb: Being beyond transmigration the altruists came in this world.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚ ਖੰਡਿ ਵਸਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bhaau bhagat upadhes kar saadhasa(n)gat sach kha(n)dd vasaae|

en.bdb: Preaching loving devotion, they, through the holy congregation reside in the abode of truth.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਾਨਸਰੋਵਰਿ ਪਰਮ ਹੰਸ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: maanasarovar param ha(n)s gurmukh sabadh surat liv laae|

en.bdb: Gurmukhs being swans of highest order (paramhains) keep their consciousness merged in Word, the Brahm.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਵਾਸੁ ਵਣਾਸਪਤਿ ਅਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਚੰਦਨ ਮਹਕਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan vaas vanaasapat afal safal cha(n)dhan mahakaae|

en.bdb: They are like sandal, which makes the fruitful and fruitless vegetation fragrant.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭਵਜਲ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਬੋਹਿਥੈ ਹੋਇ ਪਰਵਾਰ ਸਧਾਰ ਲੰਘਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: bhavajal a(n)dhar bohithai hoi paravaar sadhaar la(n)ghaae|

en.bdb: Into the world ocean they are like that vessel which takes the whole family across comfortably.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਹਰਿ ਤਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਵਿਆਪਈ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਏ।
verses.translit_en: lahar tara(n)g na viaapiee maiaa vich udhaas rahaae|

en.bdb: They remain undistributed and detached amid the waves of worldly phenomena.
Remaining absorbed in the equipoise is the delightful fruit if the gurmukhs.
